architecture: bounded constructed neural i32 WebAssembly experiment

workload_suites.scope: 19 public programs + 8 independent held-out generated programs; exact canonical source WASM and state traces
workload_suites.gate: all witnessed instruction-state fields match v51/v56/v57 and original Wasmtime; no tolerance

workload_suites.scope: 16 public + 8 held-out straight-line generated WASM programs
workload_suites.gate: all source PCs, stacks, locals, halt flags match independent v51/v57

workload_suites.scope: same source program and argument on v51/v56/v57/v58/Wasmtime
workload_suites.gate: report median p95 raw samples and geometric mean paired comparisons; exclude compilation from timed segment
report observed instructions; distinguish cost from constant-opcode program count

workload_suites.scope: generated seeds 128..135 excluded from public generated 0..15
workload_suites.gate: separate public and holdout; disclose finite coverage and no arbitrary WASM percentage

workload_suites.scope: 10 activated analytic weight or source-token mutations
workload_suites.gate: record exceptions and full trace divergence; preserve all undetected cases

workload_suites.scope: vary instruction length, operand depth and frame nesting within admitted capacities
workload_suites.gate: pending: build scaling variant and measure under pinned thread/host settings; report max admitted sizes

workload_suites.scope: Linux Windows x86-64 ARM64 CPUs; other hardware only if measured
workload_suites.gate: pending independently measured platform inventory, no inferred device support

comparability.aggregation: geometric mean over paired matching cases; also report p10 speedup, median speedup, worst slowdown and fraction slower

notes: Benchmark specification is not a measured result. v58 experimental executor admits straight-line data WASM only; v57 handles restricted structured control.
